headline_item.title_zh: 美国司法部启动DoorDash收购Instacart反垄断审查
headline_item.title_en: Sources: the US DOJ will review DoorDash's ~$17B acquisition of Instacart; DoorDash has agreed to pay a $1.25B breakup fee if the deal fails antitrust review (Jody Godoy/Reuters)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美国司法部将审查DoorDash斥资约170亿美元收购Instacart的交易，该协议包含12.5亿美元的终止违约金
headline_item.event_summary_en: The US Department of Justice is launching an antitrust review of DoorDash's proposed $17 billion acquisition of Instacart to assess potential competitive harm in the grocery delivery market. DoorDash has contractually agreed to pay a $1.25 billion breakup fee should the merger fail to receive regulatory clearance.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】DoorDash、Instacart、美国司法部(DOJ)在美国反垄断监管审查：启动170亿美元并购审查，设立12.5亿美元违约金
【起因与机理】旨在巩固杂货配送市场份额，引发对行业竞争水平的担忧
【关键数据与实测】DOJ启动针对170亿美元并购案的反垄断审查。
【行业影响与走向】审查核心在于杂货配送市场的竞争格局影响。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] DoorDash, Instacart, US Department of Justice (DOJ) (US antitrust regulatory review): Initiation of $17B merger review with a $1.25B breakup fee
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Strategic push into grocery delivery raising competition concerns
[Key Metrics] DOJ antitrust review of the $17B acquisition.
[Key Position & Outlook] Core focus on market competition within grocery delivery.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此案是美国平台经济领域反垄断审查的高标尺，司法部旨在抑制配送领域的高度集中化趋势，以防范算法定价对终端价格的操纵。若该并购受阻，将迫使DoorDash及同类平台转向通过有机扩张或细分垂直赛道收购来实现增长，而非通过横向合并收割市场。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This case sets a high benchmark for antitrust scrutiny in the platform economy, with the DOJ aiming to curb extreme concentration in delivery services to prevent algorithmic price manipulation. Should the merger be blocked, it will force DoorDash and its peers to pivot toward organic growth or niche vertical acquisitions rather than horizontal market consolidation.

headlines.title_zh: 预测市场平台Kalshi收购券商布局股票交易
headlines.title_en: Sources: Kalshi bought FB Securities, a small New York-based broker, in July and plans to launch equity trading within the next two months (Vicky Ge Huang/Wall Street Journal)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 预测市场平台Kalshi于7月收购纽约经纪商FB Securities，计划在两个月内推出股票与ETF交易功能
headlines.event_summary_en: Prediction-market platform Kalshi acquired New York-based broker-dealer FB Securities in July as part of a strategic shift toward traditional financial assets. The company plans to launch stock and ETF trading services within the next two months to expand its multi-asset capabilities.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】卡尔希、FB证券在纽约金融监管环境：完成对FB Securities的收购并筹备股票及ETF交易业务
【起因与机理】寻求突破单一预测合约限制，实现平台资产类别多元化
【调查与监管诉求】预测市场平台Kalshi在7月完成了对纽约小型经纪商FB Securities的收购，正致力于将其业务版图扩展至传统金融资产领域。
【行业影响与走向】在预测市场面临严峻州级法律挑战的背景下，切入高流动性的股权交易是其缓解单一商业模式风险、提升整体估值溢价的必然选择。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Kalshi, FB Securities: Acquisition of FB Securities and preparation for stock/ETF trading
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Diversification beyond prediction contracts into traditional assets
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Prediction-market platform Kalshi acquired New York-based broker-dealer FB Securities in July as part of a strategic shift toward traditional financial assets.

[Industry Impact & Outlook] Amidst severe state-level legal challenges, pivoting toward high-liquidity equity trading is a strategic move to mitigate single-business-model risks and enhance overall valuation.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: Kalshi此举意在通过收购牌照获得合规入场券，从而将现有的博弈类流量转化为高频金融交易需求。在预测市场面临严峻州级法律挑战的背景下，切入高流动性的股权交易是其缓解单一商业模式风险、提升整体估值溢价的必然选择。
headlines.industry_impact_en: By acquiring a licensed entity, Kalshi is securing its regulatory entry point to convert existing gambling-style traffic into high-frequency financial trading volume. Amidst severe state-level legal challenges, pivoting toward high-liquidity equity trading is a strategic move to mitigate single-business-model risks and enhance overall valuation.

headlines.title_zh: Optimizely供应链被攻陷，百余家大型机构面临安全威胁
headlines.title_en: Researchers find Optimizely serving malicious JavaScript to sites of 178 orgs including Zoom, CNN, HSBC, Salesforce, GitLab, Ledger, BBC, Equifax, IKEA, more (Scott Helme/Report URI Blog)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 2026年11月16日，Optimizely平台被植入恶意JavaScript代码，导致包括Zoom、BBC及汇丰银行在内的178家机构网站受感染
headlines.event_summary_en: The Optimizely Web experimentation platform suffered a supply chain attack where attackers injected malicious code into the Project JavaScript field, affecting 178 organizations including Zoom, CNN, and HSBC. The payload enabled cryptocurrency theft, payment card skimming, data exfiltration, and the delivery of Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits via legitimate CDN scripts.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Optimizely（Web实验平台供应商）；受影响机构包括Zoom、CNN、汇丰银行、Salesforce、GitLab等：攻击者通过Optimizely控制面板篡改Project JavaScript，导致下游网站加载恶意脚本，引发资产窃取与iOS漏洞攻击
【起因与机理】第三方依赖项的信任机制被利用，绕过了单一企业网站自身的安全基础设施防护
【关键技术规格】Optimizely平台被非法篡改，恶意JS代码通过合法CDN分发。
【各方立场与态度】第三方依赖项信任机制引发的供应链安全隐患。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Optimizely; impacted organizations include Zoom, CNN, HSBC, Salesforce, GitLab, etc.: Attackers manipulated the Project JavaScript field to inject malicious scripts, leading to asset theft and iOS exploit delivery
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Exploitation of implicit trust in third-party CDN-served dependencies bypassing local security infrastructure
[Key Fact Detail] Optimizely platform compromised, distributing malicious JS via legitimate CDN.
[Key Position & Outlook] Systemic vulnerability caused by excessive trust in third-party dependencies.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此事件标志着现代Web架构中‘CDN即信任源’的范式漏洞被彻底放大，第三方脚本执行权限缺乏细粒度隔离已成为企业的系统性软肋。即使拥有完备的主站安全防护，企业若无强制执行内容安全策略（CSP）与子资源完整性（SRI）校验，仍无法阻断此类经由合法第三方基础设施转递的复杂供应链攻击。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This incident highlights the systemic vulnerability in modern web architectures where CDNs are treated as inherently trusted sources without fine-grained execution isolation. Even with robust perimeter security, organizations lacking enforced Content Security Policy (CSP) and Subresource Integrity (SRI) remain exposed to complex supply chain compromises delivered via legitimate third-party infrastructure.
